desc: Pursuant to Reg 30 read with Schedule III - Para A  and Regulation 47 of the SEBI (LODR) Reg, 2015, please find enclosed the copies of the Newspaper Advertisement published on Wednesday September 02, 2026, in Financial Express- English and Makkal Kural- Tamil, informing the Members about the 04th Annual General Meeting of the Company.

Pursuant to Reg 30 of SEBI LODR, Newspaper Advertisement has been Published in English and Regional language on 4th September 2026 with respect to Dispatch of Notice for 04th AGM, Cut-off Date and E-Voting.
